body:
Create a square supportive-frog sticker sheet in a clean 3-by-3 grid. Use an original tiny green frog with a yellow scarf, handmade clay texture and soft studio lighting.

Keep the frog and scarf consistent. Use simple supportive gestures such as a thumbs-up, an offered flower, a small celebration and open arms. Make the tone sincere and friendly.

Exactly nine stickers, read left to right, top to bottom. Give every sticker a distinct expression and pose that clearly matches its caption. Keep the character identity, proportions, outfit and colors consistent across all nine cells. Use generous equal spacing and a simple pale background. Make each silhouette clear, with a white die-cut border. Render each supplied English caption exactly once, verbatim, in large bold lettering inside its own cell, using no more than two lines. The captions, in reading order, are:
{{captions}}

No extra titles, watermarks, overlapping cells or additional text.

help.en: Exactly nine short captions in reading order; up to 28 characters each.

en.title: Tiny Frog, Big Support
en.description: Nine clay frog stickers offer encouragement, small celebrations and permission to rest.
en.body:
## How to use

No reference image is required. Copy the prompt and generate one image. Keep all lettering in English.

## What to check

Inspect identity, layout and every requested caption at full size and at phone display size. This is a static image; individual sticker export is a separate workflow.
